Recent_Telemetry.insertion_rule: FIFO circular buffer storing latest N=500 raw feature observations

Confirmed_Attacks.insertion_rule: Verified true positive alerts confirmed by analyst feedback or high-confidence IOCs
Confirmed_Attacks.training_use: Supervised loss reinforcement during continual fine-tuning
Confirmed_Attacks.parameter_update_effect: Prevents catastrophic forgetting on signatured attack patterns

Hard_Negatives.insertion_rule: False positives identified via analyst abstention / triage feedback
Hard_Negatives.training_use: Decision boundary sharpening via margin-based loss penalty

Drift_Samples.insertion_rule: Telemetry events exhibiting Welford drift score > 2.5 or high Wasserstein distance
Drift_Samples.training_use: Fast adaptation update step on new distribution centroids
Drift_Samples.parameter_update_effect: Accelerates recovery from non-stationary distribution shifts

Class_Prototypes.insertion_rule: K-means clustered exemplar centroids per known attack family and benign baseline
Class_Prototypes.parameter_update_effect: Preserves core manifold geometry across continual updates
